name: DocuSeal
description: DocuSeal 3.3.1 is an open-source platform to create, fill, and sign PDF documents.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  docuseal:
    image: docuseal/docuseal:3.3.3@sha256:28d0ca583860e2c73e5b068756023a93a325799a22da1f788355d566865dd051
    container_name: docuseal
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/data
notes: Open http://localhost:20031 and finish the first-run setup. Data stays in the SQLite database on the docuseal_data volume. Host port 3000 is already used by other apps, so this listing publishes 20031.
